description.html: The SOBO AL-500P is a slim 9 W LED light for aquariums 50 to 60 cm long. It rests on the aquarium rims on metal brackets, so it also suits tanks without a lid. For smaller aquariums of 40 to 50 cm, see the AL-400P.

According to the packaging, the lamp has a sleek, compact design, saves energy while giving bright light, enhances the natural colors of fish and plants and has a long service life. LED light barely warms the water, so it also suits tanks with fish that dislike warm water. A good choice for standard 60 cm aquariums.

Switch aquarium lighting on and off at the same times every day, ideally with a timer, so fish and plants have a steady day-night rhythm. Too much light and direct sunlight encourage algae. Wipe limescale and dust off the lamp from time to time, as deposits reduce light output.
